title: Adopted limit: a king recapture illegal for a non-flying-general reason still counts as protection
rationale: mx-chs-010 plus the white horse on b4, the single change; the horse covers c6, so c7c6 is illegal for a reason other than the flying general. The accepted interpretation judges a general as sole defender on the flying-generals condition alone, so the cannon still counts as protected here and the repetition stays neutral. The fixture deliberately under-detects: a strict recapture test would instead make Red lose, and this fixture is what a change to that interpretation would have to amend.
